intro k hr
have h1 : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ↑n * p n) Filter.atTop (nhds r) := hr
have h2 : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ↑n * p n) Filter.atTop (nhds r) := hr
have h3 : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => p n) Filter.atTop (nhds (r / ↑k)) := by
  refine' (Filter.tendsto.prod_mk _ _).symm
  · exact h1
  · have : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ↑n) Filter.atTop (nhds (↑k)) := by
      exact Filter.tendsto_const_mul (nhds (↑k)) (Filter.atTop)
    refine' (Filter.tendsto.mul_left _ _).symm
    · exact h1
    · exact this
have h4 : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => p n ^ k) Filter.atTop (nhds (r ^ k)) := by
  induction' k with k hk
  · exact (Filter.tendsto_const_nhds _).symm
  · refine' (Filter.tendsto.pow _ _).symm
    · exact h3
    · exact h3
have h5 : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ↑(n.choose k)) Filter.atTop (nhds (↑k.factorial)) := by
  exact Binomial.tendsto_choose_at_top k
have h6 : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ↑(n.choose k) * p n ^ k) Filter.atTop (nhds (↑k.factorial * r ^ k)) := by
  refine' (Filter.tendsto.mul_left _ _).symm
  · exact h5
  · exact h4
have h7 : nhds (↑k.factorial * r ^ k) = nhds (r ^ k / ↑k.factorial) := by
  rw [nhds_mul, nhds_div]
  exact (mul_right_inj' (↑k.factorial)).symm
refine' (Filter.cong (nhds (r ^ k / ↑k.factorial)) _).symm
  exact h6
